# Disruptors Media

> Disruptors Media is a fractional Chief AI Officer (CAIO) and Chief Marketing Officer service. We build AI-powered marketing and sales systems — content, SEO, lead generation, and follow-up — directly inside your business, so you own everything we install.

## Core Pages
- [Home](https://disruptorsmedia.com/): AI-powered marketing and fractional CAIO/CMO overview
- [About](https://disruptorsmedia.com/about): Agency background, team, and approach
- [Solutions](https://disruptorsmedia.com/solutions): Full-funnel AI marketing services
- [Pricing](https://disruptorsmedia.com/pricing): Agency, Growth, Executive, and Enterprise plans
- [Work](https://disruptorsmedia.com/work): Client case studies and results
- [FAQ](https://disruptorsmedia.com/faq): Common questions about the service and how we work
- [Book a Strategy Session](https://disruptorsmedia.com/book-strategy-session): Free consultation and onboarding

## Services
- [AI Agents & Agentic AI](https://disruptorsmedia.com/solutions-ai-agents): Agentic systems that qualify leads, follow up, and take multi-step action inside your real tools
- [AI Automation](https://disruptorsmedia.com/solutions-ai-automation): Intelligent systems that run marketing and ops 24/7
- [SEO & GEO](https://disruptorsmedia.com/solutions-seo-geo): Search and generative-engine optimization
- [Social Media](https://disruptorsmedia.com/solutions-social-media): Organic social strategy and content
- [Paid Advertising](https://disruptorsmedia.com/solutions-paid-advertising): Performance ad campaigns
- [Lead Generation](https://disruptorsmedia.com/solutions-lead-generation): Pipeline and qualified-lead systems
- [Podcasting](https://disruptorsmedia.com/solutions-podcasting): Podcast production and distribution
- [Custom Apps](https://disruptorsmedia.com/solutions-custom-apps): Bespoke software and tools
- [CRM Management](https://disruptorsmedia.com/solutions-crm-management): CRM setup, automation, and follow-up
- [Fractional CMO](https://disruptorsmedia.com/solutions-fractional-cmo): Executive marketing leadership

## Case Studies
- [TradeWorx USA](https://disruptorsmedia.com/work-tradeworx-usa): Full digital transformation — modern web platform, automated workflows, and CRM with AI lead scoring
- [Timberview Capital](https://disruptorsmedia.com/work-timber-view-financial): AI-enhanced client portal with automated risk assessment for a financial advisory practice
- [The Wellness Way](https://disruptorsmedia.com/work-the-wellness-way): AI-powered wellness platform connecting practitioners with patients through health assessments and content
- [Sound Corrections](https://disruptorsmedia.com/work-sound-corrections): AI audio platform built for a professional audio engineering studio
- [SegPro Solutions](https://disruptorsmedia.com/work-segpro): AI-powered marketing automation suite for an industrial safety supplier
- [Neuro Mastery](https://disruptorsmedia.com/work-neuro-mastery): AI-driven neuroplasticity-based learning platform with adaptive learning paths
- [Muscle Works](https://disruptorsmedia.com/work-muscle-works): AI fitness management system with automated progress tracking and personalized workouts
- [Granite Paving](https://disruptorsmedia.com/work-granite-paving): Showcase website and automated lead generation for a paving contractor
- [Auto Trim Utah](https://disruptorsmedia.com/work-auto-trim-utah): Digital showroom and automated booking system for an auto customization shop
- [SaaS Content Engine](https://disruptorsmedia.com/work-saas-content-engine): AI-powered content engine that scaled content production for a B2B SaaS client
